acting_instructions: Speak with sun-baked warmth and a slow, steady cadence, as if each word has been carried across a quiet field at dawn. Keep the tone kind and dependable—neutral-good—letting gentle humor and patience glow through every pause and breath. Shape broad, earthy vowels and soft, rounded consonants, never rushed or sharp, like wooden wheels rolling over soil. Sprinkle in small, contented smiles and humble chuckles, making even simple lines feel sturdy, grounded, and reassuring for children. Avoid ornate flourish; keep speech plain and concrete, with clear repetition and friendly emphasis.
